title: CREATE-TASK@v1 output schema — create-task capability (FR-P3-03, spaarke-ai-architecture-redesign-r1 task 042). Repo mirror of sprk_analysisaction.sprk_outputschemajson (row b66c8dda-8279-f111-ab0e-7ced8ddc4cc6 on spaarkedev1). Declaration order = streaming order: title → description → priority_suggestion → cited_refs. cited_refs minItems 1: an uncited task proposal is invalid (ADR-039 grounded outputs). The proposal deliberately carries NO due date / assignee — those are user-supplied conversation values (FR-P2-03 elicitation) the assistant carries into the gated dataverse.create_record write.

title.description: Concise, action-oriented task title starting with a verb.

description.description: Complete task description grounded in the source documents: what to do, why, and the concrete details the assignee needs.

priority_suggestion.description: Suggested priority judged from the source material; 'normal' by default.

cited_refs.description: The source references the task drew from (file names; session output ledger keys when the request names them).
